description: This file defines data pipe classes for batching, unbatching, and grouping data in the PyTorch data pipeline, including classes BatcherIterDataPipe, UnBatcherIterDataPipe, and GrouperIterDataPipe.

classes.name: BatcherIterDataPipe
classes.description: Creates mini-batches of data from an iterable DataPipe, with options to drop incomplete batches and apply a wrapper class.

classes.name: UnBatcherIterDataPipe
classes.description: Flattens batched data from an iterable DataPipe up to a specified level, effectively undoing batching.

classes.name: GrouperIterDataPipe
classes.description: Groups data from an iterable DataPipe by a key function, yielding groups with a maximum size, with options for guaranteed group size and dropping remaining smaller groups.

methods.name: BatcherIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes batching DataPipe with batch size, drop_last option, and wrapper class.

methods.name: BatcherIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the source DataPipe, yielding batched data chunks.

methods.name: BatcherIterDataPipe.__len__
methods.description: Returns the number of batches if the source DataPipe has a defined length.

methods.name: UnBatcherIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes unbatching DataPipe with unbatch level.

methods.name: UnBatcherIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the source DataPipe, yielding flattened data up to the specified level.

methods.name: _dive
methods.description: Recursively yields elements from nested lists or DataChunks based on unbatch level.

methods.name: GrouperIterDataPipe.__init__
methods.description: Initializes grouping DataPipe with key function, buffer size, group size, guaranteed group size, and options to keep key and drop remaining groups.

methods.name: _remove_biggest_key
methods.description: Removes and returns the largest group from the buffer based on group size and guarantees.

methods.name: GrouperIterDataPipe.__iter__
methods.description: Iterates over the source DataPipe, grouping data by key and yielding groups based on size constraints.

methods.name: GrouperIterDataPipe.__getstate__
methods.description: Serializes the state of the DataPipe.

methods.name: GrouperIterDataPipe.__setstate__
methods.description: Restores the state of the DataPipe from serialized data.

methods.name: GrouperIterDataPipe.__del__
methods.description: Clears the buffer elements upon deletion.
